senses.gloss: m. (a further corrupt. of פַּרְדִּיסְקֵי I, v. Perl. Et. St. p. 132) officer, policeman.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 12b:13">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Esther 1:22">Esth. I, 22</cite>) <he>פשיטא אפי׳ קרחה בביתיה פ׳ ליהוי</he> (Ar. <he>פרדכ׳</he>; Ms. M. <he>פרדנ׳</he>, read <cite ref="K00000"><he>כ</he></cite> for <cite ref="N00001"><he>נ</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) is it not a matter of course? Even a weaver—in his house he must be the police; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1051:3">Yalk. Esth. 1051</cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 94a:4">Sabb. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא פ׳ דרתח וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>פרשדכא</he>) a certain officer with whom the king was wroth.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1053">Yalk. Esth. 1053</cite> <he>פרדשכי</he>, v. next w.]
